text: In a textile factory after closing, Paul is killed by [a woman with claw-like hands who vanishes whenever the lights come on|archetypes|The Rule]. His young son Martin, kept awake by his mother Sophie talking to someone she calls Diana, turns to his half-sister Rebecca, who heard the same conversations as a child. Old records reveal Diana as [a girl Sophie met in a mental hospital, burned to ashes by an experimental light treatment|origin|the wronged dead return], who [will not let Sophie go|wants|keeping people forever].
